justification: Fixes three confirmed silent-wrong-result defects from the #745 audit that are user-facing today: a legit-empty coastal check rendered as a data gap, a granny-flat card showing a confident zero-buildings count when detection actually FAILED (the classic silent false negative), and two different lot areas served in one brief. All fixes follow the DataField three-state contract; critical because these shape user decisions on hazards and eligibility.

pre_impl.existing_data: No stored data changes: DataField construction and the detect request/response schema change at call time only; older clients omitting lot_area_m2/detection_failed keep working (both optional with safe defaults).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A caller not sending lot_area_m2 falls back to the geometry shoelace exactly as before; a response without detection_failed reads as false in the UI, matching pre-change rendering for successful detections.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every future brief/detect run; nothing persisted needs migration.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Modal HTTP failure now RAISES at the call boundary and surfaces as detection_failed with a warning — never byte-identical to a genuine zero.
pre_impl.frontend_type: GfState result variant gains detectionFailed and detectionWarnings optional fields; GrannyFlatCard gains an optional lotAreaM2 prop — tsc 0 errors, jest 768 passed.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Coastal checked-clear shows as a clear check (not a gap); failed building scans read count unknown-not-zero; every card in one brief cites one lot area.

functions.name: _build_environmental
functions.input: portal controls plus overlay query results and failure flags
functions.output: the EnvironmentalConstraints model whose coastal_hazards field now honours the three-state DataField contract on legit-empty results
functions.if_none: zero coastal layers on a SUCCESSFUL query keeps the overlay success confidence with reason None; only a genuine overlay failure is NOT_AVAILABLE with reason

functions.name: detect_structures
functions.input: GrannyFlatDetectRequest, now optionally carrying the reconciled brief lot_area_m2
functions.output: a GrannyFlatDetectResponse carrying the three-state samgeo_structure_count together with the new detection_failed flag and warnings
functions.if_none: caller-supplied lot area wins over the geometry shoelace; detection failure yields count None plus detection_failed True plus a warning that the count is unknown, not zero

functions.name: _detect_structures_samgeo
functions.input: aerial tile path, tile bbox, and optional lot geometry sent to the Modal endpoint
functions.output: structure list on success; raises RuntimeError on any call failure
functions.if_none: the old blanket except returned an empty list making failure byte-identical to genuine zero — now the caller records the failure distinctly

values.value: coastal_layers on a successful overlay query
values.if_missing: value None with overlay success confidence and reason None — collect_gaps never lists it
geometry shoelace fallback used, identical to pre-change behaviour

values.value: detection_failed / warnings on the detect response
values.if_missing: absent flag reads false so successful detections render exactly as before

break_it.scenario: Successful coastal overlay query with zero layers rendered under Data Gaps with good-news copy on the live Concord brief
break_it.what_happens: A checked-clear result reads as missing data, contradicting the report's own gap semantics
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py coastal_hazards keeps overlay_auth confidence with reason None on legit-empty; collect_gaps exclusion pinned in test

break_it.scenario: Contributions lookup succeeding with zero plans coded as NOT_AVAILABLE plus reason, the same contract violation as coastal
break_it.what_happens: A legit-empty contributions result would surface as a data gap in the development brief
break_it.how: contributions_field now propagates the fetch's own confidence and reason; only a real failure is NOT_AVAILABLE
break_it.repro: pytest tests/test_brief_failclosed.py plus the brief contract suites in the full run

break_it.scenario: Modal detection endpoint fails and the card shows zero existing buildings detected on a lot with a house (live Concord brief)
break_it.what_happens: Users read a confident zero where the truth is unknown — the worst silent false negative in the report
break_it.how: inner call boundary raises; endpoint marks detection_failed with count None; card renders unknown-not-zero and never the count line

break_it.scenario: A genuine zero-structure detection gets misread as a failure after the three-state change
break_it.what_happens: Real empty lots would lose their legitimate zero count and show a false unavailable state
break_it.how: successful empty detection keeps count 0 with detection_failed False — pinned in its own test

break_it.scenario: Two different lot areas rendered in one brief (487 vs 505 on the live Concord run)
break_it.what_happens: SEPP eligibility text and the granny-flat card disagree about the lot size, undermining trust in every number
break_it.how: detect request accepts the reconciled brief lot_area_m2 preferred over the shoelace; the page passes planningCtx.lotAreaM2 through route.ts in both dev-direct and Trigger paths
